ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR(
AND( ISPICKVAL(Deal_Level__c , "2"), ISBLANK( Level_1_Approver__c ) ),
NOT( Level_1_Approver__r.IsActive ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(Deal_Level__c , "2"), ISBLANK( Level_1_Approver_Backup__c ) ),
NOT( Level_1_Approver_Backup__r.IsActive ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(Deal_Level__c , "2"), ISBLANK( Level_2_Commercial_Approver__c ) ),
NOT( Level_2_Commercial_Approver__r.IsActive ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(Deal_Level__c , "2"), ISBLANK( Level_2_Commercial_Approver_Backup__c ) ),
NOT( Level_2_Commercial_Approver_Backup__r.IsActive ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(Deal_Level__c , "2"), ISBLANK( Level_2_Finance_Approver__c ) ),
NOT( Level_2_Finance_Approver__r.IsActive ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(Deal_Level__c , "2"), ISBLANK( Level_2_Finance_Approver_Backup__c ) ),
NOT( Level_2_Finance_Approver_Backup__r.IsActive )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please specify Active Users for all Deal Level 1 and 2 approvers (including backups)
